question: What is the name of the tool used for force amplification?
solution:
The correct answer is __Lever**(Option 1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lever__ is a simple machine used for force amplification.
 
• A lever consists of a rigid bar that rotates around a fixed point known as the fulcrum.
 
• It works based on the principle of mechanical advantage, allowing a small effort to move a larger load.
 
• Levers are classified into three types: first-class, second-class, and third-class levers.
 
• Examples of levers include seesaws, crowbars, and scissors.
 
• Levers are widely used in engineering and daily life for lifting, cutting, and prying objects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Wheel:**

 
 
• A wheel is a circular component that rotates on an axle and is used for transportation or movement.
 
• It does not amplify force but reduces friction when moving objects.
 
 
 
• **Allen Key:**
 
 
• An Allen key is a tool used to drive screws and bolts with hexagonal sockets.
 
• It is not used for force amplification but for tightening or loosening fasteners.
 
 
 
• **Screwdriver:**
 
 
• A screwdriver is a tool used to drive screws into surfaces.
 
• It is primarily used for applying torque, not force amplification.
